translations.web: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: and set them in two rows—six per row—on the table of pure gold before the LORD.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
translations.asv: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before Jehovah.
